column2: A galvanized steel bucket has a silvery zinc-spangled surface, with one enlarged patch showing the distinctive crystalline coating.
A surprised child opens their mouth very wide while looking upward at an enormous floating parade balloon.
A stern supervisor forces a reluctant worker toward an unfinished task, blocking the doorway and pointing insistently at it.
A jacket combines clashing neon patches, oversized sequins and bright feathers, overwhelming the simple mannequin wearing it.
A bulky car stands beside a fuel pump, with several empty fuel cans piled near its open fuel flap.
A simplified torso cutaway highlights the stomach and connected intestines as one continuous digestive region, without unrelated organs.
A gatherer collects fallen pine cones into a wicker basket, bending beside a scattered patch beneath a tree.
A geneticist compares DNA diagrams on a laboratory screen, with a sample rack and microscope beside the workstation.
A geologist examines layered rock with a hand lens, holding a chipped specimen beside an exposed cliff face.
A researcher studies an older volunteer's walking balance, with a chair, measuring equipment and a clinical notebook nearby.
Many small pebbles form one coherent bird silhouette on a flat surface, with the overall outline immediately recognizable.
An artisan smooths a delicate sheet of gold leaf onto a carved wooden frame using a soft gilding brush.
An elegantly dressed performer entrances an audience, standing in a graceful pose while spectators gaze with delighted expressions.
A worker gathers scattered grain stalks left behind in a harvested field, holding a small bundle against one arm.
A glum child sits with downturned mouth and slumped shoulders beside a canceled outdoor picnic's packed basket.
An overfull diner leans back with a rounded stomach, surrounded by empty dishes after eating an enormous meal.
A squirrel gnaws a hard nut between its front teeth, gripping the shell tightly with both forepaws.
A herder holds a long slender wooden goad beside a resting ox, with the pointed tip clearly visible.
Protective goggles have clear wraparound lenses, a padded seal and an adjustable strap, shown beside a woodworking tool.
Several small sweets fill a shallow dish, including wrapped caramels, chocolate pieces and one decorated biscuit.
A vendor hands a free apple to a delighted passerby, with the customer's purse remaining closed in their other hand.
Several children drift toward a street musician, leaving scattered positions to gather closely around the playing violinist.
A flock of small birds crowds together on one branch, leaving nearby branches completely empty.
A slender greyhound runs in profile, displaying its deep chest, narrow waist, long legs and streamlined muzzle.
Cars block one another across a busy crossroads, forming a tightly interlocked traffic jam with no clear exit.
A person feels along a dark hallway wall with both hands, carefully searching for the light switch.
An accuser points angrily at an innocent child beside a completely intact vase, while the child looks bewildered.
A child's grubby hands and muddy sleeves contrast with a clean white towel held by a waiting parent.
A reluctant child grudgingly gives up a toy, extending it with a tight frown while looking away.
An innocent child holds up empty hands while a mischievous cat is caught knocking a cup from the table.
A gullible shopper eagerly buys an ordinary pebble from a grinning seller presenting it on an extravagant cushion.
A baby lies comfortably in a caregiver's arms, making a bubbling throat sound with an open relaxed mouth.
A gynecologist consults an adult patient at a desk, using a clear anatomical uterus model beside the medical notes.
A hale older adult carries two full watering cans steadily across a garden, standing upright with an energetic smile.
A worker drags a heavy sack across a rough floor, leaning backward and gripping its tied mouth tightly.
Football players rest on a sideline bench during halftime, drinking water while their coach addresses the gathered team.
Two neighbors greet each other cheerfully across a garden gate, one lifting an open hand in welcome.
A hand grips a sturdy handrail alongside three steps, with the rail's wall brackets and continuous slope visible.
A hand writes an uneven personal note with a fountain pen, showing cursive strokes without forming readable words.
A historical executioner stands beside an empty gallows platform, holding a folded hood; show no prisoner or execution.
A thick hardcover book lies partly open, revealing rigid boards projecting slightly beyond its flexible paper pages.
A listener leans forward with one hand cupped behind an ear, attentively facing a quietly playing flute musician.
A harried parent juggles a ringing phone, spilled groceries and a crying toddler, with a visibly strained expression.
Several small birds repeatedly swoop at a larger hawk, driving it away from their nest without visible injury.
A faded former stage performer sits beside a dusty trophy and worn costume, watching newer performers receive applause.
An ornate jeweled headdress rests on a plain display stand, its feathers and rounded ornaments contained within the frame.
A headless stone statue stands on a pedestal, with a clearly broken neck stump and both arms intact.
A balanced meal of vegetables, beans and fish sits beside walking shoes and a glass of water.
An adult holds a returned gift and a wilted flower, pressing the other hand to their chest with a pained expression.
A simplified anatomical heart contracts in one clear view, with small motion marks around its muscular outline.
A grateful adult embraces a rescuer warmly, closing their eyes and holding them tightly beside a recovered pet.
A teammate encourages an exhausted runner with a hand on their shoulder, helping them stand upright again.
A pleasure-seeking adult reclines among soft cushions, enjoying fine food and music while unattended work waits nearby.
A medieval helmet rests on a wooden bench, showing its rounded metal shell, nose guard and leather chin strap.
A soft green herbaceous stem bends between two fingers, with leaves along it and no woody bark.
An adult withdraws into a cozy room for winter, surrounded by blankets and books while snow gathers outside.
A hiker climbs a rocky trail with trekking poles, wearing sturdy boots and a compact backpack.
Two identical blue cups stand side by side, matching exactly in size, handle shape and painted stripe.
A honeybee lands on a flower, showing a striped fuzzy abdomen, paired wings and pollen on its hind legs.
A driver presses a car horn while a startled pedestrian turns toward the car's front grille.
A street hooligan kicks over a rubbish bin, with scattered litter and alarmed pedestrians stepping away nearby.
A laptop shows a tiny HTML document containing a heading tag, beside a simple rendered heading in its browser window.
A derelict ship hulk rests partly submerged beside a deserted dock, with a broken mast and rusted empty hull.
An office worker monotonously stamps identical envelopes from a huge stack, wearing a tired expression at a plain desk.
A riderless shopping trolley hurtles down a steep ramp, its wheels bouncing and loose groceries flying behind it.
A hydrangea shrub bears large rounded clusters of blue and pink florets above broad serrated green leaves.
Water flows through a dam's turbine and turns a generator, with the reservoir and downstream channel visible in cutaway.
A coach instills confidence in a nervous beginner, helping them straighten their posture before stepping onto the court.
An immature adult throws a childish tantrum over a board game, pushing pieces away while companions wait calmly.
A nurse administers a vaccine injection to a seated patient's upper arm, with clean gloves and a sharps container nearby.
An impostor wears another worker's distinctive jacket and copied portrait badge, slipping into the workplace behind staff.
A speaker whispers across a large noisy workshop, while the distant listener cups an ear and looks puzzled.
An indecisive shopper holds two nearly identical coats, repeatedly comparing them with a worried face before a mirror.
A child too short for a ride stands below its height bar, while the attendant gently prevents entry.
An inexperienced carpenter holds a saw backward at a workbench, while an experienced coworker gently corrects their grip.
A traveler examines an information display of a simple station map, with pictorial routes and service symbols only.
A prankster spills paint across a freshly cleaned floor, making its cleaner clench both fists in fury.
A rescued traveler walks away ignoring the helper who holds their recovered luggage, leaving the helper visibly disappointed.
Five small wheels stand precisely in one straight line, with their centers aligned along a taut guide string.
An inventor demonstrates a newly designed folding wheelchair, while older rigid chairs stand unused beside the workbench.
A judge examines evidence at a formal hearing, listening closely as a witness gestures toward an object on the table.
A farmer scatters seeds by hand across freshly tilled furrows, carrying a cloth seed bag at the hip.
A small fishing boat travels close along the shoreline, with shallow rocks and coastal houses clearly nearby.
A student smirks while pretending to attend a serious lesson, hiding a toy under the desk.
A technician installs a wall-mounted lamp, securing its base above a workbench with the power disconnected.
A worker wraps a hot water pipe in a thick insulating sleeve, leaving one short section visible before covering it.
Representatives from three public agencies exchange folders around a shared conference table, each wearing a distinct plain badge.
A long-distance airplane crosses an ocean between two separate continental coastlines on one simplified globe view.
Two metal chain links pass through each other, with their curved loops clearly locked together under tension.
A small spacecraft travels between Earth and Mars, with both planets distinct and one curved route joining them.
Two intermeshing gears rotate together, each gear's teeth directly driving the other in one compact mechanism.
An adult sways unsteadily after drinking wine, gripping a chair while an empty glass rests nearby.
A magnified cell cutaway highlights a small structure inside the enclosing membrane, with the outer boundary fully visible.
An intricate mechanical clock exposes many interlocking gears, coiled springs and carefully fitted levers within one small housing.
A flexible earthworm bends around a pebble, with its segmented soft body shown without any backbone or limbs.
A small silvery iridium sample rests in a protective display case, with only its chemical symbol on the holder.
A person brings beach equipment to a formal office meeting, while suited participants look puzzled around the conference table.
An adult cradles a unique handmade childhood doll, ignoring a shelf of new factory-made toys offered as replacements.
A dripping tap repeatedly lands drops in a metal sink, while an annoyed adult covers one ear nearby.
An excited child jabbers rapidly to a patient adult, gesturing with both hands while barely pausing for breath.
A hollow orange jack-o'-lantern has triangular eyes, a toothy cutout grin and a small glowing candle inside.
A delighted contest winner receives a large tray of prize coins, holding a winning ticket beside the presenter.
A jaded traveler slumps over a suitcase, eyelids heavy and shoulders sagging after a long journey.
A child watches a sibling's larger birthday present jealously, gripping their own small package with a tight frown.
A friend playfully teases a cyclist about a crooked helmet, smiling while the cyclist laughs and adjusts it.
A hurried commuter jostles another passenger with an elbow while squeezing through the crowded train doorway.
A jubilant athlete leaps into the air with both fists raised, beside teammates celebrating the finish.
A community anniversary celebration gathers adults around a ceremonial cake, with festive bunting and an old town portrait.
Several uniformed military rulers sit behind a government desk, with armed guards stationed at the chamber entrance.
Roasting juices collect beneath a browned joint of meat, with a spoon lifting the clear brown jus from the pan.
A historical German emperor sits on a throne wearing imperial ceremonial dress and a crown, holding an orb and scepter.
A drill kicks backward in a worker's gloved hands when its bit catches, with the restrained workpiece clearly visible.
A kidnapper forces an unwilling adult toward a waiting van, while the captive reaches outward for help; no weapons or injury.
A tall glass of pale golden lager has a clear body, rising bubbles and a compact white foam head.
A historical overseer raises a whip toward a cart horse, without contact, wounds or a visible blow.
A neglected playground lies littered and broken, while a parent and child survey the damage with sorrowful expressions.
A single streetlamp stands on a tall iron post, casting a small pool of light over a pavement bench.
A wilted potted flower droops over its container, with limp leaves and a bent stem above dry soil.
A neglected houseplant has drooping leaves, yellowed lower foliage and a weak thin stem beside an unused watering can.
A barber spreads thick white soap lather over an adult's cheeks with a shaving brush, leaving the eyes clear.
An instructor applauds a student's finished wood carving, presenting it proudly while the student smiles modestly beside the bench.
An adult attempts to shelter under a tiny doll's umbrella during heavy rain, drawing amused smiles from passersby.
A criminal funnels a bag of illicit cash through a sham shop, hiding it beneath apparently ordinary sales receipts.
A push lawn mower cuts a neat strip through tall grass, showing its handle, grass catcher and four small wheels.
A shopkeeper sets aside a wrapped coat behind the counter while a customer contributes a small installment of coins.
A government official removes a prohibition barrier from a market stall, allowing a waiting vendor to reopen legally.
A formal letter sheet has a small embossed company emblem centered at its top, above blank writing space.
An official opens a formerly restricted town gate, allowing citizens to gather and exchange goods freely inside.
A rescuer throws a coiled lifeline toward an adult struggling in water, keeping the near end secured on shore.
A life-size human mannequin stands directly beside an adult of the same height, with matching shoulder and head levels.
A transparent sealed sample tube contains dark red blood, beside a small visible droplet on a clean glass slide.
A remarkably lifelike wax dog sits beside a real dog, matching its fur texture and alert posture closely.
A teacher compares a child's curled sleeping posture to a curled kitten, showing both shapes beside each other.
A lioness stands on a rock beside two cubs, showing a powerful tawny body and a head without a mane.
A shop owner sells the final fixtures and empties the till, leaving bare shelves and a stack of settled receipts.
A lighter dessert contains a small portion of yogurt and berries beside a larger rich cream cake left untouched.
A comfortable small apartment has daylight, a tidy kitchen, a sturdy bed and ample clear walking space.
A warehouse loader lifts a heavy crate onto a lorry bed, bending the knees while a coworker steadies it.
A lobbyist presents a policy folder to a legislator outside a meeting chamber, leaning forward in focused persuasion.
A lodger carries a suitcase into a rented upstairs bedroom while the householder hands over a room key.
Two teenagers loiter outside a closed shop, leaning against its wall with no apparent task or destination.
An ancient stone settlement has rough dwellings, clay pots and a wood fire, with no modern objects present.
A loon floats low on a lake, showing its pointed bill, dark head, white neck bands and patterned back.
A loyalist stands beside a threatened ruler, firmly holding the ruler's plain banner while a protesting crowd approaches.
A mechanic adds a drop of lubricating oil to a stiff hinge, holding a small oilcan above its joint.
An adult lugs a heavy trunk across the floor, pulling its handle with both hands and leaning forward.
A lusty toddler laughs loudly while splashing bath water, arms raised and cheeks bright with energy.
A child hugs a beloved stuffed bear tightly, smiling with closed eyes and pressing their cheek against its head.
A muscular adult strikes an exaggerated strongman pose, flexing both arms beside a set of heavy barbells.
A loud dripping ceiling leak maddens a tired resident, who grips their hair beside overflowing buckets.
Several pale legless maggots cluster on a decaying fruit fragment, with segmented tapered bodies and no adult flies.
An immense waterfall pours magnificently between towering cliffs, with a tiny foreground tree establishing its grand scale.
A historical warship carries rows of gunports along its hull and several square-rigged masts above the deck.
An artist repeats the same stiff decorative pose across several almost identical figurines, looking bored beside the workbench.
A shopkeeper adds an extra stack of coins beside the original coin price of the same displayed shoe.
A marshmallow plant displays pale pink five-petaled flowers, soft downy leaves and a tall upright herbaceous stem.
A skilled violinist performs confidently with precise bow placement, while the attentive audience watches the controlled graceful movement.
A mother bends affectionately over her young child, fastening the child's coat beside the open family doorway.
A city mayor chairs a municipal meeting, wearing a ceremonial chain and gesturing toward a model of the town.
A lush meadow contains tall pasture grass and small wildflowers, with a grazing cow near a low fence.
Mealworms crawl through a shallow tray of grain, showing golden-brown segmented bodies, small heads and short front legs.
A craft judge studies an ordinary uneven pottery bowl, showing neither delight nor disgust beside more impressive exhibits.
A small boat sails across the blue Mediterranean beside a rocky coast, olive trees and whitewashed seaside houses.
A student covers a pattern of colored shapes, then reconstructs it from memory using loose tiles on the desk.
A meteorologist studies cloud movement, rainfall gauges and wind instruments at a compact outdoor weather station.
A microscope view shows tiny single-celled organisms with varied rounded shapes suspended in a droplet of pond water.
A millipede curls gently across a leaf, with a long cylindrical segmented body and many short paired legs.
A minder supervises two small children at a playground, tying one child's shoe while keeping the other nearby.
A cautious deminer studies a roped-off field, with a shallow cutaway revealing buried mines beneath otherwise ordinary grass.
An unreliable guide points a traveler toward a dead-end path, while the correct open path branches visibly the other way.
A lid that is too small sits crookedly on a large jar, leaving a clear gap around its rim.
A visitor mistakes a sculpted coat rack for a person, politely offering it a handshake while a bystander watches.
An absent-minded adult places a toothbrush inside a refrigerator, with the bathroom cup still empty nearby.
A young woman walks briskly with a book bag, wearing ordinary casual clothes and a cheerful attentive expression.
A potter shapes clay on a wheel while another uses hand-built coils at the same table, showing two working methods.
A skier bends their knees over rounded snow moguls, weaving between the closely spaced bumps on a ski slope.
A gardener lightly sprays water over dry seed compost, making its surface darker without flooding the tray.
